components.name: PostgreSQL
components.authority: Sole core durable fact store; it does not own Go business decisions or device effects.
components.failure: Writers fail closed; WAL/archive/standby and isolated restore procedures preserve or fence facts.
components.rollback: Restore the prior verified physical backup and rotate target/model incarnations before writers.
components.exit: Migrate only through requirement-approved transactional semantics and full data/recovery requalification.

components.name: PgBouncer
components.authority: Bounded transaction pooling and TLS admission only; it owns no session fact or database route truth.
components.failure: Clients fail within bounded queue/query deadlines; no plaintext or session-pooling fallback is enabled.
components.rollback: Rebuild the previous reviewed exact source archive and re-run pooling/TLS gates.
components.exit: Replace behind the PostgreSQL wire boundary with equivalent transaction pooling and full requalification.

components.name: Go toolchain and standard library
components.authority: Builds one-shot migration, inspection and bounded qualification workload tools only.
components.failure: Tool build or one-shot execution fails closed; applications never auto-run migrations.
components.rollback: Rebuild with the prior qualified exact toolchain.
components.exit: Replace through a full toolchain and migration-runner requalification.

components.name: github.com/jackc/pgx/v5
components.authority: PostgreSQL wire, typed scan and bounded pooling adapter only.
components.failure: Connection/transaction operations return bounded errors and do not publish migration history.
components.rollback: Pin the prior non-vulnerable compatible release and rerun all real PostgreSQL gates.
components.exit: Replace behind the db tooling adapters without changing SQL contracts.

components.name: github.com/jackc/pgpassfile
components.exit: Removed with pgx or explicit connection parsing.

components.name: github.com/jackc/puddle/v2
components.authority: Bounded test workload connection pooling only; PgBouncer remains the deployment pool boundary.

components.name: golang.org/x/sync
components.failure: The calling operation is cancelled or fails.

components.name: golang.org/x/text
components.failure: Malformed text or authentication setup fails.

components.name: golang builder image
components.authority: Reproducible build stage only; absent from runtime.
components.failure: OCI build fails and no image is published.
components.rollback: Use the prior qualified immutable builder digest.
components.exit: Replace after reproducible rebuild and scanner gates.

components.name: Alpine Linux PgBouncer base
components.authority: Minimal non-root PgBouncer build/runtime filesystem only.
components.rollback: Use the prior immutable base digest.
components.exit: Replace after source rebuild and TLS/pool requalification.

components.name: OpenSSL
components.authority: TLS 1.3 and certificate verification primitives for PgBouncer.
components.failure: TLS startup or handshake fails with no plaintext fallback.
components.rollback: Pin the prior non-vulnerable Alpine package snapshot and rebuild.
components.exit: Replace only with equivalent project-qualified TLS primitives.

components.name: libevent
components.authority: PgBouncer event loop only; owns no durable queue.
components.failure: PgBouncer exits and clients fail within bounded deadlines.
components.rollback: Pin the prior compatible package snapshot.
components.exit: Rebuild PgBouncer against a qualified event library.

components.name: c-ares
components.authority: Bounded asynchronous DNS resolution for PgBouncer upstream host only.
components.failure: Upstream connection attempts fail within configured deadlines.
components.rollback: Pin the prior compatible package snapshot.
components.exit: Build PgBouncer with the reviewed alternative resolver.

components.name: tianon/gosu
components.authority: Drops the PostgreSQL entrypoint from root to the fixed postgres UID; it owns no database privilege or fact.
components.failure: PostgreSQL container initialization/startup fails before accepting connections.
components.rollback: Rebuild the same exact gosu source with the prior security-supported Go toolchain.
components.exit: Replace the privilege-drop helper while preserving the official entrypoint boundary and rerun OCI/security/recovery gates.
